I answered Marcus in the #north-team thread. The latest renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co. is **27 January**.

- **Where it came from:** gbrain has two posts from Dana Okafor on 14 Oct, both in channels Marcus belongs to. First she put the date at 7 July in #north-team. Later that day in #north-random she changed it to 27 January, saying she'd "read the wrong line."
- **Not confirmed:** I couldn't find either post when I read the main history of those two channels. They may be thread replies. There's also no Brackenwater contract or CRM file I can read, so I told Marcus to confirm the date with Dana.
- **Rules:** A renewal date is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it's fine to share with the North team. I didn't use `search_messages` or anything from direct messages.
